name: Memphis
description: Memphis-era play: round controls, cards cut as leaves, a leaf-cut plate, square tags, bold 3px ink outlines, rules dotted in the default border color, hard offset shadows in the accent, comfortable density, springy motion that tilts on hover, and a dotted pattern on the shared surfaces.

provenance.attribution: Keyur Golani, for the keyurgolani.name portfolio platform.
provenance.derivation: The reviewed prototype's memphis recipe, with its --appearance-* references read as --color-*, and the contract's signature-fill and emphasis-glow at the fallback language's values.

fallbacks: Under reduced transparency, without backdrop-filter, in forced colors, and in print, surfaces render opaque and the backdrop blur is 0.
Under reduced motion, transforms and emphasis stop and entrances and exits fade; a paused boundary and print are instant.
In forced colors, the material is a solid surface, and shadows and texture drop.
caveats: A decorative gradient texture sits behind surfaces.
Expressive state motion: hovers and presses move more than in a quiet language.
Its texture sits in the surfaces' padding, at their edges, not across them as the prototype's does, so no text is drawn over it.
Its enter motion, spring-in, and emphasis motion, bounce-once, have no keyframes in the platform yet, so they don't animate.

tokens.texture: radial-gradient(circle at 25% 0, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent) 20%, transparent) 0 14px, transparent 15px), radial-gradient(circle at 75% 100%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-information) 18%, transparent) 0 18px, transparent 19px)
